                                                               Post Hearing Brief of G31 Landowners
                                                                             PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                          Page 1 of 4
 As testiﬁed during the hearing, safety is the primary concern for our community on
proposed link G31. Speciﬁcally, G31 parallels and crosses the Matterhorn Express Pipeline
(42" gas) and the Eiger Express Pipeline (48" gas, in-service mid-2028) and routes directly
adjacent to the Florence/Matterhorn Compressor Station (Tract #2181) which is planned to
double in size. Fireﬂy Rocket Ranch test facility lies near the west end of G31 (near Briggs).
Therefore, we are concerned about the close positioning of the G31 route to the
compressor station area and the rocket testing facility area.
As the panel testiﬁed, they were not aware of the Eiger Express Pipeline and therefore
routing did not consider the expanded Eiger compressor station. Per the Monday, June
8, 2026, transcript of the Hearing on Merits page 191 starting on line 3, Mr. Marusak
acknowledged he was not aware of the Eiger Express Pipeline as the routing witness.
Based on available information, the Compressor Station area will double in size with the
planned expansion to the south of the current Compressor Station. Based on the attached
exhibit from our direct testimony (page 31 of 33, included below), the proposed route
would go over the expanding compressor station as the station can not expand to the north
or east due to the Flood plain as noted in page 14 of 33 from our direct testimony (included
below).
Additionally, the Fireﬂy Rocket Ranch testing facility has regular testing activity and related
emergency responses due to explosions during testing activity.
In summary, we continue to respectfully request that SOAH and PUC reject any route that
avoids co-location with the Matterhorn/Eiger pipeline-compressor complex, and that
avoids the Fireﬂy Rocket Ranch for the safety of the community. From landowners that live
and work in the G31 proposed route area, placing major electric infrastructure near Fireﬂy
and the Compressor Stations increases the consequences of incidents and complicates
emergency access.
